# SC-03: Five titles make one reorder list

## Steps
1. Fill the reorder form with 5 titles from last month's paper reorders.
2. Open the list for the distributor.

## Expected result
One list with the 5 titles and quantities is ready to send to the distributor (1 case).

## Data (by pointer only)
Source: last month's paper reorders; records: 5 titles the shop manager picks; count: 5; fields: title, quantity.
